topics.title: Step by step, how to add a new saint
topics.text:
.         ADD A PERSON 
  a)  Saint fills in form
  b)  Phonelist approver makes Active
------------------------

  -- Step by step --
  a) Initiated by phonelist helper
       text ADD (get link to form)
  b) Form can be filled in by saint
  c) Phonelist approver must activate
       text name (shows id)
       text SET ACTIVE id
  *Adding a couple
       add 2 saints
       make both saints active
       text SET COUPLE  id1 id2

         NEW CELL NO. 
  -  search 'saint's name' (gets id) 
  -  use HIM/HER id to get Edit link
  -  forward link to the saint, or you can make the change

topics.title: See list of commands
topics.text:
.     COMMANDS & USAGE 

*  Before you do the SET, 
search for their name to get id

     SAINT IS BEING ADDED
    -  ADD
    -  SET ACTIVE  *id
 --------------
          ADDING A COUPLE
    -  ADD two saints
    -  SET ACTIVE  *id1
    -  SET ACTIVE  *id2
    -  SET COUPLE  *id1  *id2

     SAINT BECOMES DORMANT
    -  SET NOT ACTIVE  *id

        SAINT MOVES AWAY
    -  SET MOVED  *id

   SAINT GOES TO THE LORD
         (OR BECOMES NEGATIVE)
    -  SET DELETED  *id

       DUPLICATE FOUND
    -  SET DUPLICATE  *id

topics.title: Step by step, adding/removing Approvers & Helpers
topics.text:
.     SETSRV COMMANDS & USAGE 

*  Before you do the SETSRV, 
search for their name to get id

     ADD HELPER or APPROVER
    -  SETSRV HELPER  *id
    -  SETSRV APPROVER *id

     REMOVE HELPER or APPROVER
    -  SETSRV NOT HELPER  *id
    -  SETSRV NOT APPROVER *id
 --------------
    - Approvers may add or remove Helpers or Approvers
    - Helpers may only add or remove Helpers
